coder_notes: Both efineptakin alfa and pembrolizumab are investigational in the single neoadjuvant/adjuvant arm, so both experimental_combination. Bevacizumab permitted for symptom control in the adjuvant phase (eligibility text only, not registered), not listed. Absolute lymphocyte count change (secondary outcome, blood) is a pharmacodynamic readout for the IL-7 agent but not a tumour molecular biomarker; captured under target_engagement only. TCR clonality coded exploratory, not matched (could be argued pharmacodynamic).
